decisions_required: CONFLICT - catalogue provenance: 9,559 catalogue listings and their import run are attached to a supplier record named 'asdas'. The specification names three lanes (Inter-Sprint, Deldo, Italian ~48h); none exists as a supplier record. What is GommaRush_ISB_Tyre_Catalogue_Import-3.xlsx and which supplier owns it? Until answered the data cannot be attributed to any lane. Blocks Phase 1.

CONFLICT - two customer-request tables: 04_SALES_SOURCING_MODEL.md specifies one customer offer to sales-order layer. Production has two parallel intakes: quote_requests (2 rows, with RPC, event log, notification state machine and the customer-visible GR-YYMMDD-NNNN counter) and client_offer_requests (0 rows, written by this repository's public form). One must be made canonical before a sales layer is built on either. Recommendation: keep quote_requests, retire client_offer_requests after repointing the website. Owner decision because it changes an approved customer-facing flow.

TAX POLICY - PFU inside the VAT base: 03_PRICING_PFU_VAT.md puts PFU into taxable_subtotal, so VAT applies to it. This matches common Italian treatment of the contributo ambientale PFU, and the no-markup-on-PFU rule matches the legal pass-through requirement. It is a tax position, not an engineering choice - confirm with the commercialista before it is encoded. Blocks Phase 3.

PRICING POLICY - rounding scope: 03_PRICING_PFU_VAT.md requires deterministic rounding but does not state whether VAT is rounded per unit or per line. On 4 tyres at cost 80.00 with 20% markup, PFU 2.60 and VAT 22%, per-unit gives 481.16 and per-line gives 481.17. Price snapshots are immutable, so this must be decided before the first snapshot is written. Blocks Phase 3.
Approve Phase 0 (schema baseline and staging reconstruction). It touches no production data and unblocks every later phase.
